⋆˙⟡ ⋆.˚ ELIOT HUANG'S BIRTHDAY GLOBAL CAMPAIGN ANNOUNCEMENT ⊹₊⟡ ⋆
 
HELLO GLOBAL STARCUPS! 

XINGQIU GLOBAL FANBASE is thrilled to announce our GLOBAL CAMPAIGN in celebration of Eliot Huang's 26th Birthday. 

Join us in honoring Eliot’s special day with a series of projects and events while creating unforgettable memories with fellow Starcups WORLDWIDE! This campaign is not just about celebrating Eliot’s milestone—it’s also a day for YOU, our global community, to come together, share joy, and celebrate the bond that unites us all. 💜

◇ ONLINE EVENT ◇

• WORLDWIDE HASHTAG PARTY
→ Rally together with Starcups across the globe to flood social media with love for Eliot! The OFFICIAL HASHTAG and TAGLINE will be revealed soon by XINGQIU GLOBAL TEAM—stay tuned! 

◇ OFFLINE EVENTS ◇

• GLOBAL BIRTHDAY AD CAMPAIGN
→ Eliot’s face will shine bright on billboards in multiple countries as part of our birthday tribute! Locations and dates will be announced later. 

• FUNDRAISING LAUNCH 
→ To bring this vision to life, we’re kicking off a birthday ad campaign fundraiser! Full details, including donation guidelines and goals, will be shared TODAY. Your support means the world! 💜

• CUPSLEEVE EVENT & FAN GATHERING IN THE PHILIPPINES
→ Celebrate Eliot’s birthday and XINGQIU CP CSE with fellow Starcups! Stay tuned for venue, dates, and event highlights—it’s going to be EPIC! 

‼️IMPORTANT NOTE: The XINGQIU GLOBAL TEAM is open to organizing and hosting offline events in other countries, with the coordination of our regional fanbase/group. We hope to host events in Indonesia and Thailand soon—please stay tuned! 💜

🚨 MORE SURPRISES COMING!
We’ve got TONS of projects in the works, online events to interactive fan initiatives. Trust us—you won’t want to miss a single update! 

This campaign is a labor of love for ELIOT and KIPUKA, and we humbly ask for your enthusiasm and participation. Let’s show Eliot how deeply he’s cherished across borders! 

— XINGQIU GLOBAL FANBASE.
